title: A study to investigate dabogratinib (TYRA-300) in participants with Low Grade Upper Tract Urothelial Carcinoma
official: A Phase 2A/B, Multi-center, Open-Label Study Evaluating the Efficacy and Safety of Dabogratinib (TYRA-300) in Participants with Low Grade Upper Tract Urothelial Carcinoma (SURF303)
summary:
Main objective: Phase 2A: 1. To evaluate the efficacy of dabogratinib in participants with LG UTUC with FGFR3 altered tumors. 2. To select the recommended dose for Phase 2B.
Phase 2B: To evaluate the efficacy of dabogratinib in participants with LG UTUC with FGFR3 altered tumors.
conditions: Low Grade Upper Tract Urothelial Carcinoma
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. 1. Participants ≥ 18 years of age at the time of informed consent and willing and able to comply with all required study procedures
2. 10. ECOG 0-2
3. 11. Pathology consists of pure urothelial carcinoma
4. 12. Adequate bone marrow, liver, and renal function.
5. 2. Confirmed LG UTUC.
6. 3. At least 5mm of marker lesion left behind
7. 4. Participants must have previous genomic report or archival/fresh tissue in addition to urine sample for retrospective genomic testing
8. 5. Identification of marker lesion(s) within 8 weeks prior to randomization
9. 6. If synchronous NMIBC, NMIBC must be fully resected and low-grade Ta or T1.
10. 7. No prior BCG administration within 1 year of date of consent
11. 8. No intravesical chemotherapy within 8 weeks prior to C1D1 (including UGN-101).
12. 9. No systemic chemotherapy within 3 months prior to C1D1
Exclusion criteria:
1. 1. Evidence or any features of high grade (HG) UTUC
2. 10. Systemic immunotherapy within 6 months prior to randomization
3. 11. Treatment with an investigational agent within 30 days or 5 half-lives from randomization, whichever is shorter; compounds with an unknown half-life will be default to 30 days.
4. 12. Prior treatment with an intravesical or intracavitary agent within 8 weeks of C1D1
5. 13. Current evidence of central serous retinopathy or retinal pigmented epithelial detachment of any grade at time of baseline examination
6. 14. Requiring use of medications that are potential inhibitors or inducers of CYP3A (prohibited list of medications)
7. 2. History of carcinoma in situ (CIS)
8. 3. History of prostatic urethral involvement
9. 4. Current or previous history of muscle invasive bladder cancer
10. 5. Current or previous history of lymph node positive and/or metastatic bladder cancer
11. 6. Evidence of squamous cell carcinoma, adenocarcinoma or undifferentiated carcinoma or small cell of the bladder
12. 7. Currently receiving systemic cancer therapy (cytotoxic or immunotherapy)
13. 8. Current or prior history of pelvic external beam radiotherapy for bladder cancer
14. 9. Current or history of receiving a prior FGFR inhibitor
